purpose: Describe selected month-end-rounded extract dates versus filing dates; no stock rankings or returns
source: SEC Financial Statement and Notes 2021 Q2 archive, sub.tsv and num.tsv
method: Select 10-K and 10-Q submissions, then unsegmented EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding facts with shares units, qtrs=0 and no co-registrant. For each accession, select the latest parseable ddate not later than the filing date; calculate filing date minus ddate in calendar days. Exclude accessions with no such date or a malformed date. The archive's readme defines ddate as rounded to the nearest month end, not the original exact XBRL date.
recomputation: A separate pandas chunk-and-join calculation on the same archive reproduced all counts, the median and the maximum. This is a second calculation by the same agent, not an independent review or data-source validation.
limitations: One quarterly extract is not a representative or complete historical universe.

The extracted ddate is month-end-rounded and the median is not the median actual as-of-to-filing delay. The archive describes datp as a proximity in days without specifying direction; verify original XBRL contexts rather than infer exact dates from this summary.
The same information may have been publicly available before the selected filing; this is not a count of proven lookahead cases.
Dimensional facts, amendments, and accessions without a selected date are excluded; the unusually large maximum shows the selection is not a freshness guarantee.
The date comparison does not validate the count, share class, security identity or source vintage.
